stem: During a prescriber call, a retail CDTM program enrolls a referred adult patient. Select all supported limitations.

choices.text: Given the described event, the patient must receive notice and consent to the retail collaboration.
On this record, actions must stay within the agreement, referral, disease states, and statutory retail scope.
The collaboration is required to be established through the written agreement and supervising-physician framework required by statute.
The pharmacist can diagnose a new unrelated disease independently.
In this setting, any walk-in patient is automatically enrolled.

explanation.core_reasoning: Assess each proposition in 'During a prescriber call, a retail CDTM program enrolls a referred adult patient. Select all supported limitations.' independently. 'Given the described event, the patient must receive notice and consent to the retail collaboration.' satisfies Retail scope; 'The pharmacist can diagnose a new unrelated disease independently.' changes its legal premise.

choice_analysis.A: 'Given the described event, the patient must receive notice and consent to the retail collaboration.': Retail scope supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.B: 'On this record, actions must stay within the agreement, referral, disease states, and statutory retail scope.': Retail scope supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.C: 'The collaboration is required to be established through the written agreement and supervising-physician framework required by statute.': Retail scope supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.D: 'The pharmacist can diagnose a new unrelated disease independently.': Retail scope contradicts this proposition.
choice_analysis.E: 'In this setting, any walk-in patient is automatically enrolled.': Retail scope contradicts this proposition.

related_facts: Retail CDTM is limited to referred and consenting adults, the diseases and actions authorized by statute, the supervising physician's agreement, and other statutory setting restrictions.
explanation.mpje_trap: Answer positions prove nothing. Test 'Given the described event, the patient must receive notice and consent to the retail collaboration.' independently, then analyze the rest.

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Retail collaborative drug therapy management scope
